question: At what auspicious time may the next ritual action be performed?
premises: The verse refers to the previously mentioned auspicious time.
The action may occur on that same day.
Alternatively it may occur on the next day.
inference: The action may be performed at the aforementioned auspicious time on that day or on the next day.
plain_english: At the aforementioned auspicious time, on that day or on the next day,
